constituentArticles.title: PMEGP assisted 63% of units under manufacturing and 93% under service
constituentArticles.text: PMEGP central sector scheme assisted 63% manufacturing and 93% service units up to Rs 10 lakh. RBI guidelines: no collateral for loans up to Rs 10 lakh.
